label: GO step, confident a2 choice, high value (early-mid episode)
explanation: Fires almost only at GO (99.8% of mass), and only when the agent is about to choose a2 with a confident policy (logit(a1)-logit(a2) < -4.4; 99.7% of mass). It never fires on a1 choices, at D2, or when the reward/action/state inputs are nonzero. A second gate is the value head: it is active only when value is in the upper-middle range (about 7.7-8.1). In practice that means early-to-mid episode, ep_trial 3-59; it is silent from trial 60 on and in the first 3 trials. GO & action==2 alone gets recall 0.99 but precision 0.28. Adding ep_trial<50 gives F1 0.72, and value>7.7 gives F1 0.81. A tighter band (7.75-8.1) reaches dev F1 0.85, but that only tunes the cutoff. Magnitude is largest on the first GO of an a2 streak, or the first after a reward (e.g. 1.0, then 0.36, then decaying over consecutive a2 repeats). Uses only observed quantities and the policy/value outputs of the model itself.

issues: Most of the factual claims hold. The recorded predicate reproduces (dev F1 0.805, test F1 0.805, mass recall 0.955). GO carries 99.8% of the activation mass and D2 has none. Units with choice > -4.44 have F1 0.003. Units with ep_trial >= 60 have 0.1% recall, and ep_trial < 3 has 0.2% recall. There is no activity when in_rew, in_action or in_state is nonzero.

There is a systematic false-positive class the explanation misses: the unit stays silent at GO right after a RARE transition on the previous trial. Predicate & (prev_common==0) has precision 0.009 on 8318 predicted dev steps (test: 0.012 on 8351). That is about 38% of all false positives. In the whole profile, prev_common==0 has 166 active steps out of 252894. This is a real dependence on the observed history, not cutoff tuning.
Adding (prev_common != 0) to the recorded predicate raises precision from 0.715 to 0.805 at the same recall (0.921), giving dev F1 0.859 and test F1 0.856.

The magnitude claim is wrong. The explanation says magnitude is largest on 'the first GO after a reward'. Per active step it is about 2x larger after an UNREWARDED trial. Mass-share / count-recall at GO is 1.64 for prev_reward==0 (with a prev_common==1 a2 choice) versus 0.83 for prev_reward==1. The 'decays over consecutive a2 repeats' part is not clearly supported either: the ratio is about 1.0 for stay==1 and for two stays in a row.

The remaining false positives sit mostly in the value 7.70-7.75 band (precision 0.23, about 12k of 21k FPs), which is the cutoff tuning the original agent already noted. The 'value < 8.1' upper bound is vacuous: adding it changes nothing.
'early-mid episode' is a correlate of the value head, not a separate condition. ep_trial < 60 adds nothing once value > 7.7 is in the predicate.
Neither the original predicate nor the improved one uses future variables. choice and value are the model's own outputs; prev_common is observed history.
